stories.title: Malayalam actor-filmmaker Sreenivasan died in Kochi on 20 December, aged 69
stories.body: the screenwriter behind Nadodikkattu and Gandhinagar 2nd Street, and director of Vadakkunokkiyanthram and Chinthavishtayaya Shyamala.
